scenes.time: Time of day not given; dim, failing light, the bright walls thinned to a film
scenes.key_moment: Forty-one needles asleep in their cradles along the Dragon's belly, the walls thin as film with open sea in the gaps, and the Threaded waiting in knots of three and four (c06.s01.p002.1, c06.s01.p002.2, c06.s01.p003.2, c06.s01.p003.3, c06.s01.p003.5)

expressions: woman with the clay tube: dry, blunt

scenes.key_moment: Anselm Rook standing easily beside his grey needle in the last cradle, in dark suit and clear glass helmet, one gloved hand on the rib where the square name is cut (c06.s02.p004.1, c06.s02.p004.2, c06.s02.p004.3, c06.s02.p004.4)

backgrounds: The Dragon's gallery, dim, last cradle at the stern
sprites: Anselm Rook in dark suit and clear glass helmet

scenes.key_moment: Wrack bound in steel mesh and towed on his face through the strong-tea brown water of the Slick, while the eels rise from the silt (c06.s03.p008.2, c06.s03.p009.2, c06.s03.p013.3, c06.s03.p013.4, c06.s03.p018.1, c06.s03.p018.2)

scenes.time: Time of day not given; days of training follow
scenes.key_moment: The needle's prow slides off a skin of water an arm's length from Wrack's shoulder, as off wet glass (c06.s04.p013.5, c06.s04.p013.6)

scenes.time: Two days and a night; ends by morning
scenes.key_moment: The worn heart's pieces laid out in order on the gallery floor, with twenty-seven Threaded standing round them in silence like a graveside (c06.s05.p008.2, c06.s05.p008.3)
